title: The Tram Above the Fire Lake
story: A rope tram carries ten glassblowers across a lake of slow lava, and Tovrenash the Cable Gnawer is chewing the anchor rope strand by strand. The rope has 90 strands, and the gnawer eats 7 strands every minute while the tram's own winch weaves 3 strands back every minute. Mr 6 does the arithmetic before he does the climbing.
question: If the rope snaps when 0 strands remain, how many minutes does Mr 6 have to get everyone across?
solution: Each minute the rope really loses 7 - 3 = 4 strands.
Mr 6 has 22.5 minutes to finish the rescue.
praise: Dividing by the gnawing rate was smart thinking — the winch weaving strands back had to be subtracted first.
hint: The gnawer removes strands but the winch adds some back; find the NET loss per minute before dividing.
victory: Mr 6 ferried all ten glassblowers over with four whole minutes to spare, then offered Tovrenash a chewy rope-shaped toffee instead. The gnawer has not touched a cable since.
imagePrompt: A shaggy long-toothed monster gnawing a thick anchor rope above a glowing orange lava lake while a small knight numeral 6 counts strands beside a swaying rope tram full of frightened glassblowers.
